items.title: Triviality of an invertible sheaf on a family product from triviality along the factors and the special fibre
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter more-morphisms.tex (More on Morphisms)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: In the relative-Picard setup (proper, flat, finitely presented morphisms f : X -> S and g : Y -> S with sections sigma, tau), an invertible sheaf L on X x_S Y whose pullbacks along 1 x tau and sigma x 1 and whose restriction to the fibre over s are trivial becomes trivial over the whole product after shrinking S around s. The retained proof is a written two-input argument: the Kunneth lemma for the fibre product makes H^1(X_s x Y_s, O) -> H^1(X_s, O) (+) H^1(Y_s, O) injective, which is precisely the hypothesis needed to apply the multi-Picard lemma (lemma-H1-O-multiple-picard-flat-proper) to the two morphisms 1 x tau and sigma x 1, and the conclusion follows. Retained author proof at lines 9634-9650.
